answer: Require each identity to post a performance bond that only unlocks after it has graded a quota of peers correctly, checked against the deterministic panel verdict. A zephyr of new accounts can register freely, but none can withdraw or vote until its grades survive audit, so every fake identity burns capital and compute for months. Weight panel seats by that audited record, and cap how much weight any single cluster of shared funding can hold, like a willow bending but not breaking under load; the glacier of accumulated honest history simply outweighs any burst of clones.
